Title: Azure API Management now supports integration with Azure App Service

Body.Content:
A new Azure API Management feature allows you to expose apps deployed in Azure App Service to manage, protect, and secure APIs. It’s now easier to publish apps to API Management from the App Service extension in the Azure portal.

To start using this feature, go to the App Service extension and follow these steps:

  1. Select a new or existing API Management service instance for exposing the app. 
  2. Manage the API—apply policies, edit or download an OpenAPI specification file, change the API configuration, or navigate to the API Management instance. 

Learn more about Azure API Management.
